caption_styles: Keep it minimal: 1-2 words like 'Pure cinema' or 'Unreal'.
Use a single relevant emoji that matches the movie vibe.
Avoid long descriptions; let the on-screen hook do the work.
Include a call to action like 'Rate this 1-10' to boost engagement.

avoid: Long intros before the hook appears.
Using low-energy music for high-intensity action scenes.
Over-editing with too many transitions that distract from the scene.
Publishing content without a clear 'drop' moment synced to the beat.
Using generic or boring fonts for the hook bar.

our_insights: High-energy edits with a clear drop (11-12s) perform 10x better than low-energy ones.
Character-focused titles ('The reason why...') drive significantly more clicks than generic descriptive titles.
Early morning slots (06:30) are currently our highest performing, likely due to fresh feed algorithm pushes.
Consistency in the 'white hook bar' layout is building brand recognition; don't change the visual format.
Avoid 'filler' edits; our lowest performing videos lack a clear emotional hook or high-impact scene.
